Class Key<T>

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.inject.Key<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the bound type
public final class Key<T> extends Object
A binding identity: a Type optionally combined with a qualifier annotation. Following Guice, a qualifier is either a marker annotation type (no attributes, matched by type) or a concrete annotation instance (attributes matter, matched by the annotation's equals). An unqualified key carries neither.
